notes.title: 🧩 Bleep Bloop Joins Steam’s Cerebral Puzzle Showcase with 90% Off
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33243736/6e51aa2ef86aafdd2ee095f6af699f6a259cab58.jpg[/img]

The cooperative puzzle game Bleep Bloop is now part of Steam’s Cerebral Puzzle Showcase, and it comes with a no-brainer deal: 90% off for a limited time.

https://youtu.be/oS1aZxi9XsM

Bleep Bloop is a minimalist co-op puzzle game where two characters must work together to solve levels that challenge both logic and coordination. Whether you play with a friend or solo, the game has been praised for its elegant design, fair difficulty, and charming visuals.

And the best part? There’s no text at all. The entire experience is visual and intuitive, making it perfect for puzzle fans who want a clean, language-free challenge.

“It’s a puzzle game, sure. But this one has a very easy solution: buy it at 90% off,” say the developers.

🎮 Why play Bleep Bloop?
🧠 Cooperative puzzles that test your brain (and your friendship).
🎨 Minimalist and charming aesthetic.
🕹️ Perfect for short, replayable sessions.
🌍 No text: accessible to players in any language.
💸 Now 90% off during the event!

The Cerebral Puzzle Showcase highlights some of the smartest puzzle games on Steam, and Bleep Bloop is featured for its clever, accessible approach to the genre.

📅 Available at a discount until June 6th.
🔗 https://store.steampowered.com/app/1010230/Bleep_Bloop/

notes.title: The Zebra-Man! is now better than ever!
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33243736/5ecb2a051197bfafe4f693a6f6230aba5cb5fc02.jpg[/img]
Hello everyone! 

Hope you are having a fantastic week! Because it's about to get better. We've brought you an update for The Zebra-Man game! It is version 2.5.3. 

In this new version we fixed minor issues, such as the lighting of the 3D levels, removed the constant pop-up every time you eliminated an enemy and solved the problem of undefined NPC pushing. 

Below you have the Patch Note of [b]version 2.5.3[/b]: 

[list]
[*] Constant Stat Update (NPCs killed) now only shows when Achievement is Unlocked
[*] Added linear damp to npcs so they are not pushed indefinitely
[*] Remade the lighting batch of 3D levels
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2055360/The_ZebraMan/
